text:
sam.k: Heads-up — planning a feature-toggle rollout for `adaptive_batch_v2` in prod tomorrow (2026-03-18) at 22:30 UTC. Goal: reduce per-token cost for long-context workloads. Will use gradual flag ramping.

ben_p: I'll own the deploy. Confirming: staged through the feature flag system, not a code deploy?

sam.k: Correct — LaunchDarkly-style flag. Plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%. Wait 10–15m between steps and validate. Safe default = `false`. Toggle id = `adaptive_batch_v2`.

carla-sre: Smoke checks I'll run during canary: `curl -fsS https://api.prod.redwood.company/health` for endpoint health, run the smoke script against canary pool, and monitor infra metrics. Acceptance: p95 latency delta < +30ms, error rate < 0.2%, host mem < 80%. If KV cache hit-rate drops >5% we pause.

dave_pm: This is backend-only (no API changes) — not customer-facing, but will post a note to #status if rollout > 30m.

sam.k: Deploy steps (short):
```
1) Flip `adaptive_batch_v2` to 5% via feature-control console
2) Run `./scripts/smoke_adaptive_batch.sh --env prod --samples 200`
3) Watch metrics (serving latency, errors, mem, cache-hit) for 15m
4) If OK, increase to 25% then 50% then 100% with 10m observation windows
```

ben_p: CLI for the smoke run if helpful: `./bin/testgen --target prod --flag adaptive_batch_v2 --count 200`

carla-sre: Rollback plan: immediate flip of `adaptive_batch_v2` -> `false`. If flag control is unavailable, fallback = redeploy previous config tag `release-2026-03-15` via deploy-bot. Conditions to rollback: sustained p95 > 250ms or error rate > 0.5% for 5m, or replica memory > 90%.

sam.k: I'll make sure the flag rollback runbook is linked and the safe-default is published in the console (metadata field `safe_default=false`).

deploy-bot: @ben_p — ready to accept deploy command. Use `/deploy canary adaptive_batch_v2 5% prod` or `/deploy rollback release-2026-03-15 prod` to trigger automation.

ben_p: Ack. I'll kick off canary at 22:30 UTC and monitor here. I'll post timestamps for each step.

carla-sre: I'll be watching infra graphs (serving/latency, cluster/mem, kv/cache_hit_rate). If I see anomalies I'll call for pause/rollback and tag @ben_p and @sam.k.

sam.k: :thumbsup: I'll also run the smoke script and paste quick output here after the canary is up.

ben_p: Owner metadata for tracking: owner=sam.k, deployer=ben_p, SLO-dashboard=/d/serving/latency?env=prod, toggle=adaptive_batch_v2.

dave_pm: Thanks all — I'll update the runbook and add a short blurb to the release notes.

carla-sre: One last ask — enable debug logging for 5m on canary nodes if we see errors. Make sure logs are forwarded to prod-log-retention for 48h.

sam.k: Noted. I'll add the logging toggle to the canary checklist.

ben_p: Kicking off at 22:30 UTC unless anyone objects. Speak now or during the window.

sam.k: No objections. Good to go.
